007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016/**
017 * Sample for dropping a Select AI conversation.
018 *
019 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, obtain a
020 * {@link Conversation} object for an existing conversation ID, call
021 * {@link Conversation#drop(boolean)}, and print whether the drop operation
022 * succeeded.</p>
023 *
024 * <p>This sample changes database state by dropping the conversation identified
025 * by {@code SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID}. Verify the conversation ID before
026 * running it.</p>
027 *
028 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
029 * <ul>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
032 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
033 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID</li>
034 * </ul>
035 *
036 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
037 * <ul>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DROP_FORCE - set to {@code true} to request force
039 *       drop. Defaults to {@code false}.</li>
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
045 * }</pre>
046 *
047 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
048 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
049 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * mvn clean install
052 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
053 * }</pre>
054 *
055 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
056 * <pre>{@code
057 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
058 *   -d samples/out \
059 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/conversation/DropConversationSample.java
060 * }</pre>
061 *
062 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
063 * <pre>{@code
064 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
065 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation.DropConversationSample
066 * }</pre>
067 *
068 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
069 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
070 * and diagnostics.</p>
071 */
072public final class DropConversationSample {
073    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DropConversationSample.class);
074
075    private DropConversationSample() {
076    }
077
078    public static void main(String[] args) {
079        String conversationId = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_ID");
080        boolean force = Boolean.parseBoolean(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DROP_FORCE", "false"));
081
082        try {
083            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
084            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(conversationId);
085            boolean dropped = conversation.drop(force);
086
087            System.out.printf("Drop conversation '%s' completed: %s%n", conversationId, dropped);
088        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
089            LOGGER.error("Failed to drop Select AI conversation '{}'.", conversationId, e);
090        }
091    }
092
093    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
094        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
095                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
096                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
097                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
098                .build();
099
100        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
101    }
102
103    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
104        String value = System.getenv(name);
105        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
106            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
107        }
108        return value;
109    }
110
111    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
112        String value = System.getenv(name);
113        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
114    }
115}
